speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. To begin our assessment, have you noticed any specific changes in the color of your urine, or have you experienced any fever and chills alongside your severe abdominal pain?

speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old female. The patient presents with a 5-day history of severe abdominal pain and cramping, accompanied by nausea and vomiting. She reports pain with urination and also experienced burning pain during sexual intercourse 3 days ago. She mentions being sexually active with one male partner, using condoms inconsistently.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Pyelonephritis. Given your age, sexual activity, and symptoms of severe abdominal pain, dysuria, and vomiting, a urine culture and complete blood count are urgently needed to confirm the infection and rule out other causes.
